name: China Reinsurance (Group) Corporation
summary: China Reinsurance (Group) Corporation and its affiliates form a leading reinsurer in China and abroad. It reports property and casualty reinsurance, life and health reinsurance, primary insurance, asset management and other segments. Cover extends to motor, property, marine, liability, credit, health, agricultural, life, aviation, energy and nuclear risks. It also provides insurance agency, brokerage, risk advisory and consulting, and investment management services, and issues bonds.
